description: This is a Java unit test class for testing the behavior of the ThingQueryCommandAdapter, which converts between different representations of queries related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies the mapping from Adaptable objects to command objects and vice versa, including handling of various specific query types and fields.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the functionality of ThingQueryCommandAdapter, including conversion to/from Adaptable representations of various query types, handling of headers, fields, and different resource paths.
